items.title: ArchiveMount
items.description:
One mount to include in an archive. `path` scopes it to a folder within the mount ("" = the
whole mount); `prefix` places its files under `prefix/` in the zip (the folded drive layout).

schema.title: MountArchiveRequest
schema.description: Zip several mounts into ONE archive (the drive folds cwd + agent-files into one tree).
